description: Users report that the login button becomes unresponsive after a failed authentication attempt. The issue is reproducible on Chrome and Firefox.
As a user I want to toggle between light and dark themes so that I can use the application comfortably in low-light environments.
The onboarding documentation is outdated and missing steps for configuring the local development environment.

summary: Increase unit test coverage for auth module
description: Current test coverage for the authentication module is below 60%. Improve it to at least 80% by adding missing unit tests.

summary: Dashboard page crashes on empty dataset
description: When there is no data the dashboard throws an uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined.
Send automated Slack messages to the #deployments channel whenever a production deployment starts or finishes.
The current connection pool logic is duplicated across three modules. Consolidate it into a single reusable utility.
Multiple users report never receiving the password reset email. SMTP logs show no outbound requests after form submission.
Users need to download tabular reports as CSV files directly from the reporting dashboard.
Authenticated sessions are expiring after only 2 minutes of inactivity instead of the configured 30 minutes.
Add TOTP-based two-factor authentication as an optional security layer for user accounts.
The user profile page takes over 8 seconds to load due to unoptimised SQL queries fetching related records.
Upgrade the production database from PostgreSQL 14 to PostgreSQL 16 to leverage new performance improvements.
Implement a drag-and-drop interface for the kanban board so users can move tickets between columns.

summary: API rate limiting returns 500 instead of 429
description: When a client exceeds the rate limit the server responds with a 500 Internal Server Error instead of the correct 429.
The ticket search endpoint returns all results in a single response regardless of dataset size causing memory issues.

summary: Add webhook support for third-party integrations
description: Allow external services to subscribe to ticket lifecycle events via configurable webhook endpoints.
Remove stale environment variables from .env.example and update the deployment runbook accordingly.

summary: Attachment upload silently fails on large files
description: Uploading attachments larger than 10 MB appears to succeed but the file is never stored on the server.

summary: Implement audit log for admin actions
description: Record all create update and delete operations performed by admins in an immutable audit log table.

summary: Mobile layout breaks on small screens
description: On viewports narrower than 375px multiple UI components overflow beyond the screen boundary.

summary: Write integration tests for the billing module
description: The billing module lacks integration tests. Add end-to-end tests covering subscription creation renewal and cancellation.
Internationalise the application to support English Spanish French and German based on browser locale.
Several error messages displayed to the user contain spelling mistakes. Review and correct all user-facing strings.
Changes to notification preferences are shown in the UI immediately but are lost after a page refresh.
Introduce role-based access control with Admin Editor and Viewer roles to restrict access to sensitive features.

summary: Optimise image assets for faster load
description: Compress and serve all static image assets in WebP format to improve page load performance.

summary: Duplicate tickets created on rapid form submission
description: Clicking the Submit button twice quickly creates two identical tickets due to missing debounce logic.
Allow users to log estimated and actual time spent on a ticket directly within the ticket detail view.
Several npm packages are multiple major versions behind. Audit and update dependencies to their latest stable releases.
